log:
alejandra: Hey team — planning to push RC2 to prod today at 16:00 PT. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?

samir: I can own the deploy window. Will be on-call and available 15:30–17:00 PT. What's the rollback plan?

alejandra: Thanks. Rollback plan: immediate revert to rc1 image via the deploy playbook, `kubectl set image deployment/inference api=redwood/inference:rc1` then run smoke job. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/deploy-rollback

frank: I'll run the pre-deploy smoke checklist and post results. Checklist I have:
- Verify canary capacity (2 pods)
- Run unit smoke tests (`./scripts/smoke.sh --fast`)
- Sanity chat prompt test (gpt-2 -> sanity prompt)
- Check metrics alarm thresholds

maya: I can do the canary monitoring dashboards during rollout. Will watch latency, 5xxs, and KV-cache hit rate.

ben: Quick CR ping — the RC2 image includes the batching fix from PR #4821. Samir, please ensure the image tag matches `rc2-2026-03-17` in the deploy manifest.

samir: Got it. I'll verify manifests and image tag before starting. I'll also run a `helm template` diff and share the output.

deploy-bot: [ticket created] Deploy ticket #D-2291 opened for RC2 -> prod. Assignee: samir. ETA: 16:00 PT.

alejandra: Approvals: @maya (monitoring) and @frank (smoke) — can you both :thumbsup: when you're set?

frank: :thumbsup: smoke checklist ready. I forked a small extra test to validate KV cache warming.

maya: :thumbsup: dashboards pinned and alerts muted for the window (will unmute after smoke pass). Notify me on thread when deploy starts.

ben: Also note: feature-flag gating the new batching path is enabled in staging but off in prod. Samir, confirm flag state in the deploy job.

samir: Confirmed — feature flag remains off for prod by default. Will toggle only after post-deploy verification and an approval.

alejandra: Final timeline:
- 15:30 PT — Samir joins and verifies manifests
- 15:45 PT — frank runs pre-deploy smoke
- 16:00 PT — deploy starts (canary -> cascade)
- 16:10 PT — smoke checks on canary
- 16:25 PT — decision to proceed to full rollout

samir: I'll post the `kubectl rollout status` and canary logs here during the window. If any metric exceeds threshold or smoke fails -> rollback initiated.

frank: One last note — I added a quick grep to catch the regression in `kv_cache.py` that caused mem spikes. If grep hits, I will abort and request immediate rollback.

maya: Also, if latency > 200ms p50 for 3 consecutive mins, we abort. Using the alert runbook criteria.

alejandra: Great. All set. samir, you're the owner. Please start the window and ping @oncall if needed. I'll be on standby.

samir: Starting pre-checks now. Will update in this thread with timestamps and small snippets.

deploy-bot: [status] D-2291: pre-checks started by samir at 1767770180.

samir: 15:36 PT — `helm template` diff looks clean, image tag verified as `rc2-2026-03-17`.

frank: 15:43 PT — pre-deploy smoke: pass (all quick tests green). Uploading logs to the ticket.

samir: 16:00 PT — kicking off canary. `kubectl apply -f manifests/prod/rc2-deploy.yaml` — canary pods starting.

samir: 16:03 PT — canary up, `kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-canary: 2/2 updated`.

maya: 16:07 PT — monitoring looks stable so far. p50 120ms, 5xx 0.2%.

frank: 16:09 PT — running canary smoke prompts, responses look sane. No obvious regressions.

samir: 16:18 PT — promoting to full rollout.

deploy-bot: [status] D-2291: rollout promoted at 1767770298.

maya: 16:22 PT — small blip in latency, corrected after scaling. p50 back to 140ms.

frank: 16:26 PT — post-rollout smoke: pass. No mem spike regressions in logs.

samir: 16:30 PT — deploy complete. No rollback needed. I'll close the ticket after a 1h observation window.

alejandra: Thanks everyone. Adding a short retro note to the release doc re: the KV grep — nice catch.

samir: Closing now. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [status] D-2291: closed by samir at 1767770360.
